detailed_description: cURL to Code is a developer tool that converts cURL commands into equivalent code in multiple programming languages. Simply paste your cURL command and instantly get working code for JavaScript (fetch), Python (requests), PHP (cURL), Go (net/http), Java (HttpClient), C# (HttpClient), Ruby (Net::HTTP), and Rust (reqwest). The tool automatically parses HTTP methods, headers, request bodies, and authentication from your cURL command. Perfect for API integration, testing, and documentation. All conversion happens locally in your browser for security.
usage_steps: Paste your cURL command in the input field
Select your target programming language from the dropdown
Click Convert to generate the code
Review the generated code in the output panel
Click Copy to copy the code to clipboard
Use Load Sample to see an example cURL command
usage_examples: Convert API documentation cURL examples to your preferred language
Generate fetch code from browser DevTools cURL exports
Create Python requests code for API automation scripts
Convert complex cURL commands with headers and authentication
